presentation.lead: Meuniance turns your numbers into simple landmarks. A personal dashboard, a real spreadsheet and your goals in one place.
presentation.featuresLead: Each tool answers one simple question: where your money goes, how much you keep, and what you’re moving toward.
presentation.feature1Text: Income, expenses and savings are summarised clearly, with the months that really matter.
presentation.feature2Text: Direct entry, formulas, Excel import and export. On a phone, you move month by month without fighting twelve columns.
presentation.feature3Text: Set an amount, a deadline and track your progress without redoing the maths.
presentation.feature4Text: You choose the person, the months and the lines they can see. Access can be revoked at any time.
presentation.privacyTitle: Your financial data is not a product.
presentation.privacyText: No ads, no commercial tracking and no resale. You stay in control of your data and can export or delete it.
presentation.previewDemoLabel: Fictional example, amounts and percentages are illustrative
presentation.pricingTitle: Pick your plan. Keep your privacy.
presentation.pricingLead: Start for free. Move to Plus or Pro when you want to share or go further.
presentation.freePitch: Everything you need to see clearly.
presentation.plusPitch: Your budget, your way, for two.
presentation.plus3: Share with 1 person: you choose the visible months and rows
presentation.proPitch: To share without limits and go further.
presentation.pro4: Temporary access that expires on its own
presentation.pricingNote: The paid Plus and Pro plans are offered under the terms of sale in force when you subscribe. Prices are indicative, no commitment. Your data stays yours: no ads, no tracking, no resale.
